name: Sales Analytics for WooCommerce
author: TechBeeps Services

sections.description:
Sales Analytics for WooCommerce is a powerful plugin designed to generate custom analytics reports for WooCommerce stores. It provides detailed insights into sales, revenue, product performance, and now introduces AI-powered analysis for smarter decision-making.

Key Features:
* AI-powered performance analysis using TechBeeps AI Analyze API
* AI Insights: High & Low Performers
* AI Revenue Insights
* Let AI reveal which payment methods drive your sales—and which don’t.
* Generate sales and revenue analytics reports.
* View analytics by payment method.
* Get detailed product analytics reports.
* Download reports in CSV or PDF format.
* Visualize data using Charts.js.
* Supports multiple currencies.

External Services

This plugin connects to an external service to generate AI-based performance insights.

  1. TechBeeps AI Analyze API
    • What it does: Generates AI-based analytical responses based on store data.
    • Data sent: Product name,order amount, revenue, currency, sales date.
    • Terms of Service
    • Privacy Policy

Support

For support and further inquiries, visit our official website: https://plugins.techbeeps.com.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  4. Navigate to the Sales Analytics for WooCommerce menu in the WooCommerce admin panel to configure and view reports.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin is designed to work with WooCommerce and requires it to function properly.

Can I export reports?

Yes, you can download reports in CSV or PDF format.

Does it support multiple currencies?

Yes, the plugin supports multiple currencies for stores with multi-currency setups.

How are charts displayed?

Charts are generated using Charts.js, providing a visual representation of your sales data.

What is the AI analysis feature?

The plugin now integrates AI-powered performance insights using our API at https://plugins.techbeeps.com/api-ai-analyze/, helping you uncover hidden trends and optimize product strategies.
